Optional, Windows only: put the 64-bit `libdvdcss-2.dll` here to get preview frames from CSS-protected DVDs when running from source. The app also offers to download it into its settings folder when previews are switched on. In a release build you can put it next to `GongoAutoRipper.exe` instead.

Download: https://download.videolan.org/pub/libdvdcss/1.2.12/win64/

It isn't needed for ripping; MakeMKV handles copy protection itself.
